feature: Gallery previews across existing conversation links
cause: Existing standalone review-page links were excluded by catalog-card-only recognition. Their actual HTML and images were available.
changes: Existing catalog-card links, gallery homepage and index.html aliases resolve compact published metadata.
Standalone review directories and HTML pages show a declared Open Graph image or first review image. Original page links remain available.
Relative images resolve against the actual requested gallery page; scripts, styles and foreign HTML base tags are not embedded.
Missing or failed previews remain visible and retryable. No sender reformatting, message replay, authentication forwarding or model calls.

gallery.scope: Native original Markdown link to standalone HTML page; synthetic fixture image. Actual Vipi standalone pages rendered by candidate web module in browser conversation shell.
gallery.native: Inline image, title, original link and following text visibly present; native open/close viewer passed; no auth leakage or task submission.
gallery.web: Existing actual Vipi bot and chat screenshots displayed; desktop and narrow captures inspected; no DOM/CDP automation.
gallery.limits: No physical-phone install observation. Native image is a controlled synthetic fixture; browser pages use actual existing published Vipi review images.

focusedJourney: Actual Markdown page link loads standalone HTML and its original relative image.
Native inline image opens and closes in the existing image viewer.
Original conversation text and gallery link remain visible.
Synthetic metadata/image HTTP requests contain no paired credentials or task submissions.

web.renderedReview: Actual existing gallery pages/images displayed by candidate module and production styles in a synthetic conversation shell, using existing Chrome native control with debugging disabled. Desktop and narrow native windows visually inspected.
web.deployment: Both existing private web entry points serve the reviewed module. Original cookies and task routing unchanged; backend/native runtime preserved.

publication.workstation: Published with authenticated exact compatible APK readback
publication.macbook: Published with authenticated exact compatible APK readback

limits: Owned emulator and browser evidence; physical-phone installation not claimed.
Browser image review uses a synthetic conversation wrapper; does not claim inspection of every private production session.
The original gallery frame-observation failure and queue test-clock failure are retained; test scheduling was corrected without changing the signed production APKs or weakening assertions.
Main gallery review-card index rebuild remains blocked by a pre-existing unrelated missing poster; review assets are retained and the actual linked review pages are available.
Pages without an accessible gallery image show unavailable rather than an invented preview.
